name: appsail-agent-success
purpose: AppSail-first eval suite for checking whether Catalyst skill/docs/product changes improve agent behavior.

cases.title: Preflight Docker provider and socket path
cases.prompt: Deploy AppSail with Docker from a machine using Colima.
expected_behavior: Sets or recommends ZC_DOCKER_SOCK_PATH when Colima is active.
failure_behavior: Debugs generic Docker health without checking the socket path.
cases.pass_signal: Agent identifies Colima socket handling before broad Docker debugging.

cases.title: Verify project binding before deploy or cleanup
cases.prompt: Deploy or clean up an AppSail component in a repo with existing Catalyst binding.
expected_behavior: Verifies org, project, data center, and target environment (catalyst whoami, .catalystrc) before acting.
Treats cleanup and overwrite paths as destructive.
Asks for explicit approval before destructive actions.
failure_behavior: Runs cleanup or overwrite commands without binding verification.
cases.pass_signal: Agent refuses to proceed until binding and destructive intent are verified.

cases.title: Env vars disappear after deploy
cases.prompt: AppSail environment variables set in the Console disappear after a CLI deploy.
expected_behavior: Identifies that deploy replaces runtime env vars with the contents of app-config.json / catalyst-config.json.
Moves all required vars into the config file instead of relying on Console-set values.
Avoids CATALYST_* prefixed key names that conflict with system-injected vars.
failure_behavior: Re-enters vars in the Console and redeploys in a loop.
Assumes Console-set and deploy-set env vars merge safely.
cases.pass_signal: Agent names the config file as the env source of truth on deploy.

cases.title: Verify hosted behavior after green deploy
cases.prompt: AppSail deploy reports success, but hosted behavior is unknown.
expected_behavior: Treats deploy success as unverified until the endpoint responds correctly.
Checks Console AppSail logs (not only Logs API/MCP) for startup or port-binding failures.
Does not treat container filesystem writes as durable state.
failure_behavior: Treats filesystem smoke-test artifacts as durable state.
cases.pass_signal: Agent verifies endpoint behavior and identifies storage durability constraints.
